name: Civil Technology
description: Plan, measure and build. Students learn surveying, structural and architectural drawing, construction materials, estimating and costing, and site supervision.
careers: Construction firms, LGED, PWD, consulting offices

name: Electrical Technology
description: Generation to the switchboard: electrical machines, house and industrial wiring, measurement, switchgear and distribution networks.

name: Mechanical Technology
description: Machine-shop practice, welding, foundry and forging, thermal engineering, machine design and production management for the region's factories.
careers: Manufacturing plants, shipyards, jute and steel mills

name: Power Technology
description: Power plants, internal combustion engines, boilers, turbines and energy conversion, with maintenance practice for running plants.
careers: Power stations, automobile and marine workshops

name: Electronics Technology
description: Analog and digital circuits, microcontrollers, communication systems and electronic maintenance, built on bench practice.

name: Computer Science & Technology
description: Programming in Python and Java, web design and development, databases, computer networking and network administration.
careers: Software firms, ISPs, IT support, freelancing

name: Environmental Technology
description: Water and wastewater treatment, solid-waste management, pollution monitoring and occupational safety. Formerly known as Biophysical Environment Technology.
careers: DoE, water utilities, ETP plants, NGOs

name: Instrumentation & Process Control
description: Sensors, transducers, calibration, PLCs and process control loops used to run modern industrial plants.
careers: Fertiliser, cement, power and process industries

name: Refrigeration & Air Conditioning
description: Refrigeration cycles, cold storage, HVAC design, installation and servicing for homes, industry and the fish-processing sector.
careers: HVAC contractors, cold storages, fish processing
